errors.text_span: Die vertikale Achse misst den Anteil am BIP in Prozent, mit einem Wertebereich von −0,5 bis 3,5, wobei die Beschriftungen in 0,5-Prozent-Schritten erfolgen.
errors.evidence: The vertical axis has a scale from -0.5 to 3.5 but the intervals do not correspond to 0.5 percent steps as they include values at every 0.25 percent.
The description does not clarify that the left chart specifically represents gross investments while the right chart shows net investments.
The description does not mention that the bars in the left chart are stacked, which is an important visual aspect.
The description does not mention the specific units of the y-axis, which is in percentages of the GDP.
